Fixed the image loading issue. The Google Places API (New) doesn't return a `uri` field on photos; it returns a `name` that must be used with the Places Photo API endpoint.

Changes:
1. Added a helper function `getPhotoUrl()` that constructs the photo URL from the photo `name`
2. Updated the image `src` to use this helper instead of accessing a non-existent `uri` field

The photo URL format is: `https://places.googleapis.com/v1/{photoName}/media?maxHeightPx=400&maxWidthPx=400&key={API_KEY}`

Images should now load correctly when clicking on restaurants or other places.
